$comment: Which Sentry errors sentry-intake.yml files for Claude (scripts/sentry-fix.ts, filterIssue). SENTRY_QUERY picks candidates in Sentry; these rules then drop what shouldn't reach the pipeline. A rule matches when every field it names matches (case-insensitive regular expressions); fields: title, culprit, type, message, url, transaction. An error is filed only if it matches an include rule (when there are any) and no exclude rule. sentry-fix.yml won't push a fix that edits this file.

exclude.reason: Transient network or database connection blips
